findings.defect: Reverses who was reading the missive.
findings.rationale: 저 is Ju Hwaran referring to herself; she wants him to reopen the missive because she was reading along.

findings.current: the huge sum of gold I’d squeezed out of the Taeeul Merciless Sword
findings.defect: Omits that he beat the Taeeul Merciless Sword and extracted the money in return.
findings.rationale: 족치며 supplies the beating, while 역으로 marks the extraction as a reversal.
findings.replacement: the huge sum of gold I’d beaten out of the Taeeul Merciless Sword in return
findings.source: 내가 태을무정검을 족치며 역으로 뜯어낸 막대한 액수의 금자는

findings.current: filling the void left by the Murong Family
findings.defect: Drops the narrator’s pointed correction from the Murong great family to the diminished Murong household.
findings.rationale: 아니 explicitly corrects 모용세가 to 모용가, marking the loss of its former standing.
findings.replacement: filling the void left by the Murong great family—or rather, what remained of the Murong household

findings.current: It was the sort of attention Wolhwa, as Branch Leader of the Lower District Sect’s Shaanxi branch, paid to a valued client.
findings.defect: Loses the explicit distinction between a personal message from Wolhwa and professional attention from a Branch Leader.
findings.rationale: 월화가 아닌 … 지부장으로서 grounds his confidence that the missive will contain business information.
findings.replacement: It wasn’t Wolhwa writing to me personally. It was the Branch Leader of the Lower District Sect’s Shaanxi branch looking after a valued client.
findings.source: 월화가 아닌 하오문 섬서 지부장으로서 신경 써 주는, 일종의 우수 고객 관리랄까.

findings.current: Whether I agreed with her or not, it was easy to recognize the voice’s owner.
findings.defect: Turns his agreement with her description into an open question.
findings.rationale: 그 말에 공감하는 것과는 별개로 sets aside an agreement already present, rather than questioning whether he agrees.
findings.replacement: I agreed with her, but that aside, it was easy to recognize the voice’s owner.
findings.source: 그 말에 공감하는 것과는 별개로, 목소리의 주인을 구분하는 것은 쉬운 일이었다.

summary: One reversed speaker, two meaningful omissions, and two smaller fidelity issues.
